From the moment you approach your Genesis G80, it presents you with
intelligent solutions. A Proximity Key heralds your presence and activates
approach lights. Walking up to your car with your hands full? The G80’s smart
trunk opens automatically for easy access to cargo capacity that’s one of the
largest in its class.9 It works by detecting the stylish key fob in your pocket or
purse. Simply wait by the trunk for a few seconds, and it opens with no need
to wave one foot awkwardly under the rear bumper like some competing
systems require.
Slip behind the wheel of the G80 3.8, and you’re greeted by an 8” touchscreen
display with split-screen functionality for viewing audio information and
navigation maps (complete with junction view lane guidance). Android Auto™
and Apple CarPlay™ – standard on every G80 model – let you make hands-
free calls or access your smartphone’s music, maps and messages with
simple voice commands. The full suite of SiriusXM Traffic & Travel Link®
services (traffic, weather, sports, stocks, movie listings, fuel price locator and
more) are also complimentary for your first 3 years.10
A large 9.2” 720p HD touchscreen display1 is your command center for a
premium navigation and multimedia system featuring Lexicon Quantum Logic
Surround Sound with Clari-Fi™ Music Restoration Technology and speed-
sensing volume control. The audio system’s 17 high-efficiency speakers are
tuned to the G80’s unique acoustics for an exceptional listening experience
at every seating position.
